desc: The Four Great Evils of the Day (1871): four Lenten lectures at the Pro-Cathedral, Kensington: the revolt of the intellect against God, the revolt of the will against God, the revolt of society from God, and the spirit of Antichrist.

editor: Henry Edward Manning (London: Burns, Oates and Co., 1871)
